instruction: Lis la question, puis écoute le récit en anglais. Pour l’entendre encore, appuie sur Écouter. Le lexique est affiché.

items.prompt:
Last Saturday, Jack and his sister Amy went to the zoo.
They took the bus at nine.
Jack wanted to see the lions.
Amy preferred the giraffes.
At noon, they had a picnic near the lake.
items.question: Quels animaux Amy préférait-elle ?
items.spoken: Last Saturday, Jack and his sister Amy went to the zoo. They took the bus at nine. Jack wanted to see the lions. Amy preferred the giraffes. At noon, they had a picnic near the lake.
items.hint: Écoute la phrase qui commence par Amy.
items.explanation: Amy preferred the giraffes = Amy préférait les girafes. Les lions, c’est Jack qui voulait les voir.

props.title: Écouter un récit au passé
lines: Écoute les prénoms : he = il (un garçon), she = elle (une fille).
went = est allé ; took = a pris ; saw = a vu ; ran = a couru ; won = a gagné
heard = a entendu ; woke up = a réveillé ; broke down = est tombée en panne ; forgot = a oublié
thirteen = 13, thirty = 30 ; Tuesday = mardi, Thursday = jeudi
neighbour = voisin, voisine ; honey = miel ; downstairs = en bas

items.prompt:
Ella’s party was on Thursday evening.
She invited her friend Noah.
Noah arrived at seven.
He gave her a book.
They danced all evening.
items.question: Quel jour était la fête d’Ella ?
items.spoken: Ella’s party was on Thursday evening. She invited her friend Noah. Noah arrived at seven. He gave her a book. They danced all evening.
items.hint: Tuesday ou Thursday ? Écoute le début du mot : « tiou », ou th, la langue entre les dents ?
items.explanation: on Thursday evening = jeudi soir. Thursday commence par th ; Tuesday (mardi) commence par « tiou ».

items.prompt:
Last summer, Omar and his cousin Leila visited Scotland.
They stayed there for thirteen days.
It rained a lot.
One day, they climbed a mountain.
Leila took a lot of photos.
items.question: Combien de jours Omar et Leila sont-ils restés en Écosse ?
items.spoken: Last summer, Omar and his cousin Leila visited Scotland. They stayed there for thirteen days. It rained a lot. One day, they climbed a mountain. Leila took a lot of photos.
items.hint: Écoute la fin du nombre : -teen ou -ty ?
items.explanation: thirteen days = 13 jours : on entend -teen à la fin, et la voix appuie dessus (thir-TEEN). Thirty (30) finit par -ty.

items.prompt:
On Monday morning, Mr Hill’s car broke down.
So he started walking to work.
His neighbour, Mrs Green, saw him in the street.
She drove him to the office.
He arrived just on time.
items.question: Pourquoi monsieur Hill est-il parti au travail à pied ?
items.spoken: On Monday morning, Mr Hill’s car broke down. So he started walking to work. His neighbour, Mrs Green, saw him in the street. She drove him to the office. He arrived just on time.
items.hint: Écoute la 1re phrase : qu’est-il arrivé à la voiture (car) de Mr Hill ?
items.explanation: Mr Hill’s car broke down = la voiture de M. Hill est tombée en panne. So (alors) il est parti à pied, jusqu’à ce que sa voisine le conduise au bureau.

items.prompt:
Last night, Sophie heard a noise in the kitchen.
She woke up her brother, Dan.
They went downstairs together.
The cat was on the table.
It was eating their chicken!
items.question: Qui faisait du bruit dans la cuisine ?
items.spoken: Last night, Sophie heard a noise in the kitchen. She woke up her brother, Dan. They went downstairs together. The cat was on the table. It was eating their chicken!
items.hint: Écoute la fin : qui était sur la table ?
items.explanation: The cat was on the table = le chat était sur la table : il mangeait leur poulet (chicken). Dan dormait : Sophie l’a réveillé (she woke up her brother).

items.prompt:
In June, Mia and Luke ran a race in the park.
Luke started very fast.
After ten minutes, he was tired.
Mia ran slowly, but she never stopped.
In the end, she won the race.
items.question: Qui a gagné la course ?
items.spoken: In June, Mia and Luke ran a race in the park. Luke started very fast. After ten minutes, he was tired. Mia ran slowly, but she never stopped. In the end, she won the race.
items.hint: Écoute la dernière phrase : he ou she won the race ?
items.explanation: In the end, she won the race = à la fin, elle a gagné la course. She = elle, c’est Mia. Luke est parti très vite, mais il était fatigué (he was tired).

items.prompt:
Last Tuesday, Kevin’s class went to a museum with Mr Brown.
They travelled by train.
A guide showed them some old boats.
Kevin asked a lot of questions.
Mr Brown took photos.
items.question: Qu’est-ce que le guide a montré à la classe ?
items.spoken: Last Tuesday, Kevin’s class went to a museum with Mr Brown. They travelled by train. A guide showed them some old boats. Kevin asked a lot of questions. Mr Brown took photos.
items.hint: Écoute la phrase qui commence par a guide.
items.explanation: A guide showed them some old boats = un guide leur a montré de vieux bateaux. Le train, c’est pour venir au musée ; les photos, c’est M. Brown qui les a prises.

items.prompt:
On Sunday morning, Grace made pancakes for her dad.
But she forgot the sugar.
Her dad tasted one and smiled.
Then he added some honey.
In the end, the pancakes were delicious.
items.question: Qu’est-ce que Grace a oublié ?
items.spoken: On Sunday morning, Grace made pancakes for her dad. But she forgot the sugar. Her dad tasted one and smiled. Then he added some honey. In the end, the pancakes were delicious.
items.hint: Oublier se dit forget, au passé forgot. Écoute la 2e phrase.
items.explanation: She forgot the sugar = elle a oublié le sucre. Le miel (honey), c’est son père qui l’a ajouté ensuite.
